secciVariant.notRequired: Your Ratepay Profile Configurations do not require SECCI (CCD2).
secciVariant.defaultPaymentMethodErrorLine1: The default payment method of the sales channel "{salesChannels}" requires SECCI. | The following sales channels have a default payment method that requires SECCI: {salesChannels}
secciVariant.defaultPaymentMethodErrorLine2: This is incompatible with SECCI banner variant "{titleAbove}". Use banner variant "{titleBelow}" or change the default payment method to one that does not require SECCI.

above.title: Automatic email delivery
above.description: The SECCI banner displays above payment methods and the SECCI is emailed to the buyer automatically, requiring no additional checkout steps.
above.alt: SECCI banner is placed above the payment methods

below.title: Explicit SECCI interaction
below.description: Upon selecting a CCD2-relevant Ratepay method, the SECCI component displays below payment methods. The buyer must download or email the SECCI, adding an extra checkout step.
below.alt: SECCI banner is placed below the payment methods
